root_problem: manual merchant onboarding takes too long and creates avoidable configuration errors
scope_boundaries: standardize intake review and account configuration for the first onboarding phase

delivery_plan.goal: deliver a guided merchant onboarding baseline

locked_fields.root_problem: manual merchant onboarding takes too long and creates avoidable configuration errors

user_profile.scenario: reviewing new merchant applications and preparing account configuration
user_profile.current_workaround: track checklist status in spreadsheets and copy settings between tools
user_profile.workaround_cost: slow turnaround, missed fields, and repeated handoff questions

appetite.complexity_ceiling: reuse existing approval and configuration systems
appetite.trim_first: advanced analytics and self-service rule builders

scope_boundaries: standardize intake review and account configuration for the first onboarding phase
non_goals: do not replace the full merchant CRM in this phase

feasibility_constraints.constraint: reuse the existing merchant account service and approval status model
feasibility_constraints.handling: limit Director scope to workflow baseline and configuration handoff

risks_and_unknowns.item: approval rules may vary by merchant category
risks_and_unknowns.impact: phase scope may need to split regulated and non-regulated merchants
risks_and_unknowns.mitigation: confirm rule categories before UNIT decomposition

decision_rationale.choice: focus phase-1 on intake review and account configuration handoff
decision_rationale.rationale: this closes the slowest manual loop before investing in advanced automation
decision_rationale.excluded_options: full CRM replacement or rule builder in phase-1
